r15-rightdrag.title: Drag with the right mouse button (optional)
body: You asked for a setting so right-click can drag. I read that as: on the Desk, hold the right button and move to drag a card, and the same for piles, areas, sliding the Desk itself, and moving the floating windows and the drawer.

**The clash with menus.** Right-click opens menus today (Bring up…, Pin, and so on). With the setting on, it depends on whether the mouse moves: press and let go without moving, and you get the menu exactly as now. Press and move a little, and it becomes a drag and no menu appears afterwards.
**Where it lives.** Settings → Look, a new Mouse line with one switch. It starts off, so nothing changes until you turn it on.
**Left as is.** Selecting with Shift or the Box tool stays on the left button, and the Day, Lists and Notes screens have no dragging, so nothing changes there.

figures.caption: Settings → Look: the new Mouse switch.
With it on: the right button held down drags the card. A plain right-click still opens its menu.

questions.placeholder: e.g. only for sliding the Desk, or on by default

r15-rightdrag.pick: Approve as shown; it's off until you switch it on.
